prompts.prompt: From our Human data, build me one page that puts each company next to its contacts: the company name, its industry, and the people there with their job titles. Group it by company. One HTML file, give me the HTML at the end.
I want a page from our Human instance that counts our contacts by contact type and shows it as a chart, with the totals underneath. One HTML file, HTML at the end.

Build me a contacts page from Human where clicking a person opens their full details beside the list — everything we hold on them, including which company they belong to. One HTML file, HTML at the end.
Make me a page showing which tasks in our Human agent sandbox are overdue and who each one is for, newest first. One HTML file, HTML at the end.
